user.title: Connect to Hermes
user.description: Point this at the Hermes Agent API server on your network.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Hermes at that URL.
error.invalid_auth: Hermes requires an API key, or the key was rejected.

abort.already_configured: This Hermes server is already configured.

data_description.timeout: Only used when async runs are off or unavailable.
data_description.use_async: Answer quickly or acknowledge, then deliver slow results later. Falls back to the sync path if Hermes has no /v1/runs endpoint.
data_description.fast_window: How long to wait for a real answer before acknowledging. 0 always acknowledges.
data_description.max_wait: Slow requests still running after this are stopped.
data_description.notify_target: For example mobile_app_pixel_11_pro. Leave empty to skip.
data_description.device_context_ttl: A new conversation on the same device within this time continues the previous one. 0 turns this off.
